title: Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Coordinator
description:
Job Description
  
  
As an Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Coordinator, you will support clients in the planning, implementation, management, and coordination of EHS requirements across operational facilities and office environments. You will play an important role in ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, promoting a strong safety culture, and supporting the effective management of environmental, health, and safety programmes.
  
  
The successful candidate will also be responsible for conducting and facilitating EHS seminars and training programmes, developing effective methods for monitoring EHS performance, and carrying out routine inspections to identify and mitigate potential workplace risks.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
Ensure compliance with all applicable environmental, health, safety, and statutory legislation, regulations, and requirements.
  
  
Provide EHS policy guidance and support to clients, management teams, employees, and other stakeholders.
  
  
Review and advise on safe work procedures in collaboration with operational and project teams.
  
  
Conduct routine workplace inspections and audits to identify hazards and assess compliance with EHS requirements.
  
  
Recommend reasonably practicable measures to eliminate or minimise foreseeable risks to employees, visitors, and contractors.
  
  
Establish and promote EHS awareness and a positive safety culture across operational facilities and office environments.
  
  
Support the implementation and monitoring of environmental programmes, including waste management, environmental compliance, and sustainability initiatives, where required by the Client.
  
  
Monitor and review EHS programmes to ensure regulatory and organisational compliance.
  
  
Manage and maintain site- or facility-specific EHS documentation in accordance with client and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Respond to incidents and emergencies, assist in investigations, recommend corrective and preventive actions, and maintain accurate records and statistics.
  
  
Prepare and submit incident reports in accordance with EHS and organisational procedures.
  
  
Support the coordination and delivery of EHS inductions, briefings, awareness programmes, and training initiatives as required.
  
  
Perform other EHS-related duties and ad hoc assignments as required by the Client.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
Opportunities are available across multiple experience levels, depending on the complexity of the assignment and scope of responsibilities.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health& Safety, Workplace Safety & Health, or a related discipline.
  
  
Up to 3 years of relevant experience in an EHS, facilities, operations, or similar environment. Experience supporting technology-sector clients will be an advantage.
  
  
Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Placement level will be determined based on qualifications, experience, and available opportunities.
  
  
Strong interest in environmental, health, and safety management and regulatory compliance.
  
  
Positive attitude with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
Stronganalytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
  
  
Strong administrative and document management skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  
  
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and documentation management.
  
  
Knowledge of EHS regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices will be an advantage.
  
  
**Employment Type:**  
Contract (1 to 2 years), with extension or renewal subject to the Client's requirements and project needs.
  
EnviroSolutions & Consulting (ESC) is the leading Environment, Safety, and Sustainability consultancy in Asia. Our international and multidisciplinary teams are uniquely equipped with Local Knowledge and Global Expertise.
  
  
We deliver comprehensive, integrated, and client-focused solutions to cover a multitude of technical disciplines. Leveraging our established professional relationships with regulatory authorities, whilst drawing on our deep local and legislative insights, we are committed to successfully managing your environment, safety, and sustainability project needs.
  
  
Trusted by clients from Asia and beyond, we are consistently recognized for our innovative services and insightful solutions to bring you exceptional value. ESC supports our regional clients with the largest local teams of experienced consultants.
  
  
Our Mission is to bring our talent, expertise, and experience across the Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) spectrum to provide smart, cost-effective and practical solutions to the EHS and Sustainability challenges our clients and the broader community face.
  
  
We invite you to develop your fullest potential, hone the right technical skills and sharpen your environment, safety, and sustainability knowledge with high performing and global team of experts.
  
  
With a collaborative and empowering culture, ESC attracts and retains multidisciplinary and excellent employees. Our talents are drawn from a mix of nationalities and professional backgrounds with an extensive Asian and international experience.

title: Environmental Control Officer (ECO)
description:
Job Descriptions
  
  
Work closely with the Project Manager and WSHO on environmental issues such as noise pollution, vector control, air pollution, water pollution and drainage, prevention & control of infectious diseases, food hygiene, solid waste management, chemical storage & disposal, and haze response procedure
  
  
Implement and monitor environmental, health, and safety management systems at worksites
  
  
Prepare, submit statutory reports and maintain documentation for environmental public health requirements on environmental issues
  
  
Ensure ECM plan is updated regularly in response to site changes
  
  
Conduct regular site inspections to ensure that site activities are carried out in compliance with NEA and EHS regulations
  
  
Liaise with NEA and relevant authorities on all environmental issues
  
  
Look out for conditions/situations in construction sites that cause or are likely to cause environmental health problems
  
  
Report these conditions/situations to the project management to ensure compliance
  
  
Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, develop environmental control plan, site clean-up plans, Safety and Health and good practice requirements at all times
  
  
Provide recommendations on remedial measures to be taken to prevent recurrence
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
Must be a registered ECO with NEA
  
  
Must be a registered Earth Control Measures Officer (ECMO) with IES
  
  
Remuneration will be commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications and relevant experience.
  
Company Introduction
  
  
Founded in 1979, Chye Joo Construction Pte Ltd is a well-established A1 civil engineering company providing cost-effective and integrated construction and building solutions in the construction industry in Singapore.
  
  
We have a varied portfolio of completed projects spanning the public and private sectors.
  
  
We pride ourselves on delivering quality projects on schedule, while not compromising on safety. Customer satisfaction is our topmost priority, and it is the foundation on which we build our business.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Applications are invited for the following full-time position in the Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health:

  

A research assistant position is available in the Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health to support the Principal Investigators in research projects in the areas of Environmental and Cancer Epidemiology.

  

Major duties and responsibility of the position include but are not limited to:
  

* Data collection and management
* Literature review
* Data analysis using software such as R, Stata or SAS.
* Designing, testing, and administering surveys and questionnaires
* Research coordination
* Preparation of reports, presentations, manuscripts.

  

The candidate must be an independent, highly motivated, and mature worker who is well-organized and demonstrates a growth mindset. Candidate must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills. He/She must have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues to achieve team goals. Good proficiency in the following areas is preferred:
  
1. Microsoft Office Applications, particularly MS Word, Excel, Powerpoint
  
2. Experience in R, Python

  

The successful applicant is expected to possess at least a Bachelor’s Degree in Epidemiology, Public Health, Environmental Health, Biological Sciences, Biostatistics, Data Science, preferably with relevant experience. Prior experience with machine learning is a plus.

  

Recruitment is open immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Applicants should send a brief statement of interest, CV, three named references, and other supporting documents during the application. In your statement of interest, please highlight your relevant experience and interest in environmental and cancer epidemiology research.

  

We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Senior / Staff Program Manager, Sustainability Operations
Consultant / Associate Consultant, Corporate Sustainability (Training and Account Management)
description:
Are you passionate about sustainability? Do you want to take action?
  
  
The need to move to a more sustainable world has never been clearer. Companies have a big part to play, but many are not sure where to start. For 15 years, Sustainable Living Lab (SL2) has helped companies see sustainability as an opportunity rather than a cost. This is a turning point, and the choices we make now can set things on a better course. Join us in helping companies (and our planet) thrive by taking up more sustainable business practices and circular business models.
  
  
About SL2
  
  
SL2 is a sustainability consultancy and innovation lab founded in Singapore in 2011. We specialise in creating and implementing rapidly evolving, impactful solutions. Our expertise lies in leveraging technology as a tool for sustainability, with a strong emphasis on a community-driven approach to implementation. Our practical yet ambitious approach has helped us build a client base across governments, international development organisations, large multinationals, and small and medium-sized companies.
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, we have established a strong presence in Asia and beyond. Our strategically located offices in India, Indonesia, and the United States enable us to effectively engage, understand, and tailor our solutions to specific contexts.
  
  
About the Team
  
  
This role is based in Singapore and sits within the Corporate Sustainability Team. You will work with clients based in multiple locations and time zones across Asia. The team helps companies transition towards more sustainable business practices. We are a close-knit team that works at pace and collaborates by default, equally comfortable leading client workshops and managing the detail behind them. With clients across the region, no two weeks are the same, and we hold ourselves to a high standard in the work we deliver.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
You will work with companies, government bodies, and Institutes of Higher Learning across several countries by training them on sustainability concepts, helping them come up with new business ideas, and co-developing technology solutions. It is a hands-on role, and you will manage client relationships as well as handle the details that keep the work running.
  
  
**The work will involve:**  
**Account Management:**  
Working with clients through scoping, proposals, and delivery, and being their main point of contact throughout.
  
  
**Training Design and Delivery:**  
Assisting with the design and delivery of training and innovation programmes on sustainability, and keeping the content current with industry trends, new regulations, and best practices.
  
  
**Programme Management:**  
Collaborating with the Corporate Sustainability Team to design, implement, and manage sustainability programmes that align with our goals.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement:**  
Building and maintaining relationships with external stakeholders to drive sustainability initiatives.
  
  
About You
  
  
You should have relevant qualifications in sustainability and/ or business innovation. Ideally, you will also have:
  
  
Minimum of 2 years relevant work experience in corporate sustainability, environmental consulting, training, or a related field.
  
  
Some experience in running or helping to run training, workshops, or programmes for adults, or a real interest in learning how.
  
  
Strong understanding of sustainability principles and frameworks (e.g. ISSB, GRI, GHG Protocol), and best practices.
  
  
A working understanding of sustainability-related issues and trends in both a local and global context.
  
  
Basic understanding of innovation processes (e.g. Design Thinking, Business Model Canvas).
  
  
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, for writing reports, delivering presentations, and engaging with stakeholders at all levels in English.
  
  
Good time management (able to handle multiple clients/projects simultaneously).
  
  
Able to adapt to ambiguous contexts of contributing to a wide range of client projects unfolding simultaneously.
  
  
Ability to accommodate working hours to suit the needs of international clients who may be in a different time zone. Time Off will be provided in line with our internal policy.
  
  
Proficiency in Google Suite online tools.
  
  
**A bonus but not a must:** Advanced Certificate in Learning and Performance certification, or willingness to work towards it, which we can support.
  
  
If you learn fast and care about the problem we are tackling but do not tick every box, apply anyway. We have found that motivation often trumps qualifications in the long run.

Our expertise lies in leveraging technology, as a tool for sustainability, with a strong emphasis on a community-driven approach to implementation.
  
  
Our practical yet ambitious approach has helped us build a client base across governments, international development organisations, leading multinational corporations (MNCs), and small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, we have established a strong presence in Asia and beyond. Our strategically located offices in India, Indonesia, and the United States allow us to effectively engage, understand, and tailor our solutions to specific contexts.

**Job Details:**  
**Contract Duration:** 12 Months (Renewable depend on performance and business needs)
  
  
**Location:** Depot road
  
  
**Working Days & Hours:** Mon - Fri, office hours
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
To support sustainability communications and content management for a product portfolio. The role serves as the bridge between technical teams, sustainability specialists, compliance stakeholders, and marketing teams, translating complex sustainability initiatives into clear, credible, and business-ready messaging for internal and external audiences.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Act as the subject matter expert for product sustainability messaging.
  
  
Translate sustainability and R&D inputs into clear narratives, claims, and proof points.
  
  
Develop, review, and maintain sustainability content for marketing materials, internal communications, sales enablement, and events.
  
  
Support sustainability claim substantiation by gathering, validating, and organizing supporting data and documentation.
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineering, product development, sustainability, supply chain, and compliance teams.
  
  
Monitor market trends and competitor sustainability communications to identify positioning opportunities and emerging themes.
  
  
Build and maintain a centralized messaging library, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and easy accessibility across teams.
  
  
Maintain records of approvals, supporting evidence, and substantiation references for claims.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Background in Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline.
  
  
Experience working with data, documentation, and claim substantiation.
  
  
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  
  
Ability to work independently in a cross-functional environment.
  
  
Familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance, or claims review processes.
  
  
Experience working with international or cross-regional teams.
